findings.subject: Resume after native pause with a completely full stale queue
findings.disposition: Addressed by explicit muted-callback restart protocol and actual-device regression coverage.
findings.detail: The reviewer originally described permanent queue blockage. start_device already allowed a muted Preparing state, so no ring reset was required. The missing usage contract and full-queue hardware coverage were real gaps. Resume now exercises restart, start muted callbacks, bounded prefill retries, then activate.

findings.subject: Permanent device fault hidden by unchanged route
findings.detail: check_route now returns Faulted before and after querying the route; injected actual-stream coverage verifies visibility and silent fault reports.

implementation_corrections: Split restart preparation from activation to avoid starvation before prefill.
Scope generation tokens to a checked unique channel identity.
Always stop native callbacks even if feed invalidation returns a permanent-fault error.
Rename the partial timing measurement to render_cost_ns and explicitly exclude telemetry/upstream work.
qualification_limits: See the separate source audit and hardware report; full callback exceptional paths, physical device lifecycle, acoustics, stress and application transport remain open.
